dz: 平德纳战役:卢修斯·艾米利乌斯·保卢斯手下的罗马人击败了战后投降的马其顿国王珀尔修斯,结束了第三次马其顿战争.
de: Battle of Pydna: Romans under Lucius Aemilius Paullus defeat Macedonian King Perseus who surrenders after the battle, ending the Third Macedonian War.
